first.rationale: Verify the two directly relevant records because activation and onboarding are both declining. A guarded onboarding simplification test is the best-supported path to improve both completion and activation without repeating the known retention risk of promotional pricing. Measure qualified activation and downstream retention, not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a guarded simplification test for SMB and simple-workspace accounts, combining reduced signup friction with a shorter onboarding path. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because the archived record shows materially higher 60-day churn when required setup steps are removed. Evaluate qualified activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-/60-day retention rather than completion alone; stop or revert if downstream retention worsens.
